items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 139:1
items.html: (To the question) See above, Answer 222. And likewise the night resembles the first day of Rosh HaShanah before the sounding of the Shofar, for ZA does not bestow upon Rachel except during the day. (Item 125. And Items 166 and 169).
